name: razor-declaration-byte-offsets-generated
body: DeclarationEmitter.LineSpan gives a Razor-generated declaration the Razor file's mapped lines, but its start/end byte offsets stay offsets into the generated C#, not the Razor file, so lines and path point at the Razor file while offsets do not. Upgrade to Razor-file offsets if anything downstream starts slicing Razor files by start/end or joining them against hunks by offset.
